node.statement: Common left-multiplier estimate, using the preceding guard node: for every W in calU, def-approximate-unitary-space gives W^dagger bold-dot W=J and a right inverse, while def-epsilon-cstar-algebra gives (1-e)||W||^2<=1 and ||L_{W^dagger}L_W-I||<=e||W||^2<=e/(1-e)<1/5. Hence L_W is injective and, since calX is finite-dimensional, bijective. Moreover ||W||<=6/5, ||L_{W^dagger}||<=(1+e)||W||<=7/5, and ||L_{W^dagger}L_W Z||>=(4/5)||Z||, so ||L_W Z||>=(4/7)||Z|| and ||L_W^{-1}||<=7/4.
